title: Trace Inspector: interactive spans timeline, correlation filters, and request breadcrumbs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a Trace Inspector view in Redwood Console to enable engineers and SREs to drill into individual inference requests. The inspector surfaces an interactive span timeline, span waterfall, correlation IDs, request breadcrumbs, and powerful filters (model, region, host, response time, error codes). The goal is to make it fast to identify latency hotspots, correlate model fallback events, and trace requests across routing, batching, and cache layers.
goals: Provide a compact, high-density timeline that shows spans inline with request metadata
Enable fast filtering by correlation ID, model variant, region, and SLO breach status
Support timeline zoom and span grouping for long-running requests and batched work
Expose useful request context (token counts, KV cache hits, chosen kernel, GPU host) without leaving the view
Integrate with existing Console traces and logs so users can pivot between a trace and its request-level details
design_decisions: Primary timeline is horizontal waterfall with collapsible span rows; spans color-coded by subsystem (routing, batcher, runtime, network)
Request header includes copyable correlation ID and a direct link to the raw span JSON and logs
Filters implemented as persistent chips above timeline; selected filters persist in URL for shareability
Details panel slides in from the right showing request payload meta, model info, cost estimate, and token deltas
Accessibility: timeline uses patterns compatible with screen readers (ARIA: role=list + labels) and keyboard-first zoom/navigation
tradeoffs_and_risks: Heavy timeline rendering for large traces could hurt Console performance; we propose incremental rendering and culling after X spans
Exposing too much raw telemetry may overwhelm non-engineer users — we provide a compact and an expanded details mode
Relying on backend-enriched spans requires backend instrumentation (timestamps, parent IDs, resource tags); until that lands some fields will show 'unavailable'
URL-shareable filters require stable filter keys from backend and careful encoding to avoid long query strings
acceptance_criteria: Clickable correlation ID copies to clipboard and opens raw trace in new tab
Filters apply within 300ms for typical 50-span traces in stage environment
Timeline shows span start/end with millisecond precision and preserves parent/child relationships
Details panel surfaces model name, model variant, quantization profile, KV cache hit count, and estimated token cost
UX passes accessibility keyboard navigation checklist and has contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for timeline colors
